requirement.en: Monitor slab-thickness faults: when signal valid, alarm immediately on fault and hold each alarm at least 500ms; on each valid fault rising edge increment counter and store FaultTimestamp into history[0] shifting older entries; accumulate runtime by CycleTime only while cutting and no fault; on power-up or invalid signal clear alarm and hold state.
requirement.zh: 监控板厚故障：信号有效时，故障为 TRUE 立即报警且每次报警至少保持 500ms；每次有效故障上升沿使计数器加 1 并把 FaultTimestamp 存入 history[0]、旧记录右移；仅在切割运行且无故障时按 CycleTime 累加运行时间；上电或信号无效时关断报警并清除保持状态。
